# Stageshow Stage

Source: https://github.com/benjitaylor/skills/tree/main/stageshow/kit
Skill version: 1.1.1. Package license: MIT (upstream package.json).
The upstream copyright notice and full license are included in `LICENSE`.

Only Stage and its 13 direct/transitive local dependencies are included. The
host imports Stage directly; no icon library or additional npm dependency is
needed. Source files are unchanged. The pinwheel lesson controls its own physics
and narration; Stage provides fitting, compact layout and reduced-motion context.
